description.zh:
向量索引算法

取值说明：
- hnswflat：不带量化压缩的 HNSW 索引（默认值）
- novam：不带量化压缩的图索引，适用于实时推荐等高性能场景
- novad：带 rabitq 量化的分区索引，适用于大规模低成本检索场景
description.en:
The vector index algorithm.

Valid values:

- `hnswflat`: (Default) An HNSW index without quantization compression.

- `novam`: A graph index without quantization compression. This algorithm is suitable for high-performance scenarios, such as real-time recommendations.

- `novad`: A partitioned index with `rabitq` quantization. This algorithm is suitable for large-scale, low-cost retrieval scenarios.

description.zh:
要创建的集合名。

> 名称需符合PostgreSQL对象名限制。
description.en:
The name of the collection to create.

> The name must comply with PostgreSQL object naming conventions.

description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region.

description.zh:
向量维度。

> 如果指定此值，会构建索引，且后续上传向量数据接口[UpsertCollectionData](~~2401493~~)的Rows.Vector长度需和此值一致。如果不指定此值，可以后续调用[CreateVectorIndex](~~2401499~~)构建索引。
description.en:
The vector dimension.

> If you specify this parameter, a vector index is created. In subsequent calls to the [UpsertCollectionData](~~2401493~~) operation, the length of `Rows.Vector` must match this dimension. If you do not specify this parameter, you must call the [CreateVectorIndex](~~2401499~~) operation to create an index later.

description.zh:
是否使用mmap构建HNSW索引，默认为0。如果数据不需要删除，且对上传数据的速度性能有要求时，建议设置为1。

取值说明：
- 0：默认采用段页式存储构建索引，这种模式可以使用PostgreSQL中的shared_buffer做缓存，支持删除和更新等操作。
- 1：该索引会采用mmap构建索引，该模式不支持删除更新等操作。

><notice>仅6.0版本支持参数ExternalStorage。7.0版本暂不支持。></notice>
description.en:
Specifies whether to use `mmap` to build the HNSW index. The default value is 0. We recommend setting this to 1 if your data does not require deletion and you need high-performance data ingestion.

Valid values:

- `0`: (Default) Builds the index by using segmented page storage. This mode can use the `shared_buffer` in PostgreSQL for caching and supports `DELETE` and `UPDATE` operations.

- `1`: Builds the index by using `mmap`. This mode does not support `DELETE` or `UPDATE` operations.

><notice>

The `ExternalStorage` parameter is available only for AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL v6.0 instances and is not supported in v7.0.

></notice>

description.zh: 用于全文检索的字段，多个字段用英文逗号（,）分隔，且字段必须属于Metadata里定义的key。
description.en: The fields to use for full-text search. Use commas (`,`) to separate multiple field names. These fields must be keys defined in the `Metadata` parameter.

description.zh:
HNSW算法构建索引时的候选集大小。取值需要>= 2*HNSW_M。

> 取值范围：
>- AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 6.0版实例：40～4000。
>- AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 7.0版实例：4～1000，默认值 64。
description.en:
The size of the candidate set for HNSW index construction. The value must be greater than or equal to `2 * HnswM`.

> Value range:
>
> - For AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V6.0 instances: 40 to 4000.
>
> - For AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V7.0 instances: 4 to 1000. The default value is 64.

description.zh:
HNSW算法中的最大邻居数。接口会根据向量维度自动设置此值，一般不需要手动设置。

> 取值范围：
>- AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 6.0版实例：1～1000。
>- AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 7.0版实例：2～100，默认值16。

> 建议根据向量维度来设置：
>- 小于等于384：16
>- 大于384小于等于768：32
>- 大于768小于等于1024：64
>- 大于1024：128
description.en:
The maximum number of neighbors for the HNSW algorithm. You do not typically need to set this parameter, as the system automatically determines a value based on the vector dimension.

> Value range:
>
> - For AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V6.0 instances: 1 to 1000.
>
> - For AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V7.0 instances: 2 to 100. The default value is 16.

> We recommend that you set this parameter based on the vector dimension:
>
> - 16 for dimensions less than or equal to 384.
>
> - 32 for dimensions greater than 384 and less than or equal to 768.
>
> - 64 for dimensions greater than 768 and less than or equal to 1024.
>
> - 128 for dimensions greater than 1024.

description.zh:
具有rds_superuser权限的管理账号名称。

> 您可以调用[CreateAccount](~~2361789~~)接口创建账号。
description.en:
The name of the management account that has the `rds_superuser` privilege.

> You can call the [CreateAccount](~~2361789~~) operation to create an account.

description.zh: 管理账号密码。
description.en: The password of the management account.

description.zh:
向量数据的元信息，为MAP格式的JSON字符串。其中key代表字段名，value代表数据类型。

> 支持的数据类型
> - 数据类型列表详见：[数据类型](~~424383~~)。
> - 其中money类型暂不支持。

><warning>id、vector、to_tsvector、source字段为保留字段，禁止使用。></warning>
description.en:
A JSON string that defines the metadata schema as a map. The keys are field names, and the values are their corresponding data types.

> Supported data types
>
> - For a list of supported data types, see [Data types](~~424383~~).
>
> - The `money` data type is not supported.

><warning>

The field names `id`, `vector`, `to_tsvector`, and `source` are reserved and cannot be used.

></warning>

description.zh: 标量索引字段，多个字段用英文逗号（,）分隔，且字段必须属于Metadata里定义的key。
description.en: The scalar index fields. Separate multiple fields with commas (`,`). The fields must be keys that are defined in `Metadata`.

description.zh:
向量构建索引时的方法。取值说明：
- l2：欧氏距离。
- ip：点积（内积）距离。
- cosine：余弦相似度。
description.en:
The distance metric used to build the vector index. Valid values:

- `l2`: Euclidean distance.

- `ip`: dot product.

- `cosine`: cosine similarity.

description.zh:
命名空间。

> 您可以通过[CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~)接口创建，通过[ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The namespace.

> You can call the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation to create a namespace or the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation to list existing namespaces.

description.zh: 用于全文检索的分词器，默认为zh_cn。
description.en: The parser for full-text search. The default is `zh_cn`.

description.zh:
索引是否开启PQ(Product quantization)算法加速，数据量大于50w时建议开启。取值说明：
- 0：关闭。
- 1：开启（默认）。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Product Quantization (PQ) for index acceleration. This is recommended for datasets with more than 500,000 entries. Valid values:

- `0`: Disabled.

- `1`: (Default) Enabled.

description.zh: 实例所在地域ID。
description.en: The ID of the region where the instance is located.

description.zh: 稀疏向量索引配置。如果传入，则创建稀疏向量索引。
description.en: The configuration for the sparse vector index. If specified, a sparse vector index is created.

description.zh: 是否支持稀疏向量。默认值：false。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable support for sparse vectors. The default value is `false`.

description.zh: 稠密向量索引配置。
description.en: The configuration for the dense vector index.

description.zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准。
description.en: The ID of the workspace, which contains multiple database instances. You must specify either `WorkspaceId` or `DBInstanceId`. If both are specified, `WorkspaceId` takes precedence.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb create-collection --db-instance-id gp-bp152460513z0000 --manager-account testaccount --manager-account-password testpassword --namespace mynamespace --collection document --dimension 1024 --full-text-retrieval-fields title,content --metadata title_:_text_,_content_:_text_,_response_:_int --parser zh_cn --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --metrics cosine --hnsw-m 64 --hnsw-ef-construction 128 --pq-enable 1 --external-storage 0 --workspace-id gp-ws-00000 --metadata-indices title --support-sparse true --sparse-vector-index-config HnswEfConstruction=128 HnswM=64 Algorithm=hnswflat --vector-index-config Nlist=256 RabitqBits=3 --algorithm hnswflat --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb CreateCollection --region cn-hangzhou --ManagerAccountPassword testpassword --MetadataIndices title --HnswEfConstruction 128 --Metadata 'title_:_text_,_content_:_text_,_response_:_int' --WorkspaceId 'gp-ws-00000' --HnswM 64 --Dimension 1024 --FullTextRetrievalFields 'title,content' --Algorithm hnswflat --Namespace mynamespace --Parser zh_cn --SparseVectorIndexConfig '{"HnswEfConstruction":128,"HnswM":64,"Algorithm":"hnswflat"}' --Metrics cosine --DBInstanceId 'gp-bp152460513z0000' --SupportSparse true --ManagerAccount testaccount --VectorIndexConfig '{"Nlist":256,"RabitqBits":3}' --Collection document --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ExternalStorage 0 --PqEnable 1
